text:
maria: Quick FYI, after last night's RBAC cleanup the scanner service account started failing in CI with 403s and KMS decrypt errors. Anyone oncall?

liam: Oncall here, what job shows the failure?

maria: pipeline #8472 reproducible. Job log: ```ERROR: scanner: failed to download artifact: access denied (403)
caused by: kms:Decrypt failed: PermissionDenied
stack: scanner/agent/runner.go:142```

raj: Sounds like keystore.decrypt got removed from the scanner SA. We rotated bindings in the cleanup at ~23:10 UTC.

jean: Triage steps: 1) fetch keystore audit logs 2) check IAM binding diffs at 2024-06-15T23:10:12Z 3) if missing, apply short-lived grant 4) export evidence to secure bucket.

maria: Audit shows `roles/keystore.decrypter` was removed from serviceAccount:scanner@infra.iam at 2024-06-15T23:10:12Z and replaced with a narrower read-only role.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident created SEC-2024-0897 "scanner pipeline failures after RBAC cleanup". Paging: @raj @maria.

liam: Recommend a time-limited IAM binding so CI can continue while we investigate. Add condition `request.time < timestamp("2024-06-16T01:30:00Z")`.

raj: I'll open infra-iam PR for a `scanner-temp-decrypt` binding for 1 hour and log the grant ID.

jean: Also export keystore audit logs and failing job artifacts to s3://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-0897/ for RCA.

maria: After applying the temp binding pipeline #8472 passes, no 403s now. We still need to redesign the role instead of regrating broad decrypt.

raj: Action items: owner=raj; mitigation=temp grant applied; evidence=exported logs+artifacts; remediation=design scoped role allowing decrypt only for artifact bucket objects via condition.

liam: Suggest adding a pre-merge infra check: GH action that simulates IAM for the scanner SA (validate keystore:decrypt) so role changes fail CI instead of production.

jean: I'll draft the GH action using `gcloud iam roles test`/simulate and add it to infra repo.

maria: For compliance, I'll add an audit note with timestamps, actor who changed binding, and temp grant ID; tagging @people-ops for postmortem.

sec-oncall-bot: SEC-2024-0897 status updated: mitigated. Postmortem scheduled 2024-06-17 15:00 UTC.

liam: Also please add an alert rule to detect bulk SAST/DAST failures with `kms:Decrypt failed` or `403` patterns so we auto-page.

maria: Filed follow-ups: GH issues #1893 (infra pre-merge IAM test), #1894 (scanner role redesign), #1895 (pipeline auth-failure alert). Closing thread; evidence retained in incident bucket. :thumbsup:
